page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr9i.36xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 144 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 6982P-C processors operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is equipped with 1536.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 10.67 GB per core.

This instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring reliance on external block storage for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. It does not bundle any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or hardware GPU accelerators.

Given the high memory density and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.hfr9i.36xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for large-scale, memory-intensive workloads that require consistent compute performance without the overhead of physical hardware management. Appropriate workloads include large in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, heavy data analytics, and memory-bound scientific simulations.
